onThisDay.fits: 26 September 1957: West Side Story opened at the Winter Garden Theatre on Broadway.
onThisDay.headline: West Side Story opened on Broadway
onThisDay.line: Bernstein, Sondheim and Robbins put Romeo and Juliet on the Upper West Side, with dancing gangs and a score like nothing before. 732 performances.

source.name: Library of Congress: West Side Story, birth of a classic
